Data Collection

Over one million voices, three platforms

Reviews were scraped using the Apify platform, then unified into a single multi-source dataset spanning every region of the Kingdom.

Google Maps

1,016,595

Structured reviews with star ratings — the primary, most organized source.

TikTok

128,412

Spontaneous, informal comments rich with emojis and dialect.

YouTube

73,555

Conversational feedback reflecting audience impressions of travel content.

Modeling

Three approaches, one fair comparison

Traditional machine learning, deep learning, and transformer architectures were each trained on the same large-scale Arabic datasets to benchmark their strengths.

Machine Learning

LinearSVC

Converts text into TF-IDF feature vectors (word + character n-grams) and learns a linear decision boundary. Fast and stable on large data.

FeaturesTF-IDF
Data Size1M+
Training Time~3 hours
Deep Learning

Bi-LSTM

Processes sequences in both directions to capture contextual dependencies, strong at modeling word order in structured reviews.

Sequence Length80 tokens
Epochs7
Training Time~10 hours
Transformer

CAMeLBERT-DA

A pre-trained Arabic-dialect transformer that uses contextual [CLS] embeddings for classification — best at deep Arabic context.

ArchitectureBERT
Epochs4–5
Training Time~10 hours
Results & Discussion

CAMeLBERT leads the field

Across the four datasets, the pre-trained transformer achieved the best overall performance — reaching 99% accuracy on TikTok — while Bi-LSTM excelled on the larger, more structured Google Maps reviews.

Key Contributions

What makes this project different

🌐

Multi-source dataset

Over 1.2M reviews from three platforms — far beyond the single-source scope of most prior studies.

🔤

Arabic-first pipeline

Dialect handling, character normalization, emoji sentiment, and code-switching all addressed.

🏷️

Custom labeling framework

Hybrid transformer + rule-based labeling for platforms without built-in ratings.

⚖️

Fair model benchmarking

ML, deep learning & transformers compared under identical conditions.

🗺️

Aspect-level insight

11 service aspects analyzed independently for actionable recommendations.

📈

Live deployment

Results delivered as interactive Power BI dashboards for decision-makers.
